definitions.explanation: A small organized group of people working together, often in schools, workplaces, or military.

examples.japanese: ⟦クラス→クラス：01084_kurasu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧5つの{班|はん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{分|わ}けた→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧。
examples.english: We divided the class into five groups.

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{調理|ちょうり}→調理：07156_chouri⟧{班|はん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{担当|たんとう}→担当：02567_tantou⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I'm in charge of the cooking team.

examples.japanese: ⟦{班長|はんちょう}→班長：19151_hanchou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}めて→決める：00858_kimeru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。

notes:
Commonly used in schools and organizations for dividing people into working groups.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{班長|はんちょう}→班長：19151_hanchou⟧ (group leader)
- {班員|はんいん} (group member)
- {救護|きゅうご}{班|はん} (rescue team)
- ⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧{班|はん} (investigation team)

USAGE IN SCHOOLS:
- Classes are often divided into {班|はん} for activities like cleaning, lunch duty, or group projects
- Each {班|はん} typically has a ⟦{班長|はんちょう}→班長：19151_hanchou⟧ (leader)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- グループ (more general term)
- チーム (team, often for sports or projects)
- ⟦{組|くみ}→組：02668_kumi⟧ (class or group)
